notes: אִשָּׁה נְבִיאָה fuses to the single word *prophetess*, headed on the morpheme carrying the lexeme, rather than leaving אִשָּׁה unrepresented (rule 30's generic-head-noun clause).
In בָּעֵת הַהִיא the demonstrative pronoun takes the one written *that* and both article morphemes are unrepresented, matching rule 41's הַמָּקוֹם הַהוּא ruling.
